title: 10 Lectures and 42 Open Problems — Constructive Kadison-Singer
exact_target: Construct efficiently the two-partition of any bounded tight frame guaranteed by Weaver’s formulation of the Kadison–Singer theorem, using universal constants.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2800605 (AMR-027-0605). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Jourdan, Peter Macgregor and He Sun, Is the Algorithmic Kadison-Singer Problem Hard? (2022), arXiv:2205.02161, Section 1, Conjecture 1 and the algorithmic question immediately following it.
